query: How do review themes differ between positive and negative Yelp sentiment?

per_column.name: mentions_service
per_column.rationale: Binary theme flag with interpretable categories; directly captures a review theme that can be segmented and compared across sentiment. Core to the query about differing themes.

per_column.name: mentions_food_quality
per_column.rationale: Clear binary theme indicator with well-separated 0/1 groups; enables comparison of food-quality mentions between positive and negative reviews.

per_column.name: mentions_wait_time
per_column.rationale: Interpretable theme flag; wait-time mentions are a meaningful associational variable to cross-tabulate against sentiment.

per_column.name: mentions_price
per_column.rationale: Binary price-theme indicator, well-separated categories, directly supports theme-vs-sentiment exploration.

per_column.name: mentions_cleanliness
per_column.rationale: Interpretable theme flag; somewhat rare (19 positives) but still yields a meaningful comparison across sentiment.

per_column.name: mentions_atmosphere
per_column.rationale: Binary atmosphere-theme indicator with clear categories; supports segmentation against the focus.

per_column.name: exclamation_count
per_column.rationale: Stylistic count with an interpretable scale that can be bucketed; associational with sentiment intensity, though more mechanical and not a 'theme' per se. Weakly informative for the theme-focused query.

per_column.name: positive_words_count
per_column.rationale: Lexicon-based positive word count is essentially a proxy of the sentiment label itself; it restates the focus rather than opening an external relationship, and reveals little about differing themes.

per_column.name: negative_words_count
per_column.rationale: Negative-lexicon count closely mirrors the sentiment label; largely restates the focus and is not an external thematic dimension.

judge.rationale: The six 'mentions_*' theme flags are exactly the kind of interpretable, well-separated segmentation variables the query needs: they let an explorer cross-tabulate distinct review themes (service, food, wait, price, cleanliness, atmosphere) against positive/negative sentiment. These squarely satisfy the exploratory claim. exclamation_count adds a mildly informative but mechanical stylistic dimension. The two lexicon word-count columns largely restate the sentiment label and are near-duplicative of the focus, weakening the set. Overall the theme flags carry strong, interpretable relationship value, so the set scores well but is dragged down by the restatement columns.
